Hi Alex / Jasmine,

Thanks — I reviewed the attached questionnaire. Below are concise answers to the items you flagged and a few clarifying notes so TeleMedX can map requirements to deployment choices quickly: 

1) BAA availability:
- Private (customer VPC) and Dedicated (reserved capacity) — YES, Redwood signs a standard BAA. Typical turnaround: 2–3 weeks after legal review for standard terms; faster if we reuse an existing template.
- Hosted API (multi-tenant) — generally NO for PHI unless there is a negotiated enterprise arrangement and additional controls (we'll need procurement + security approval). For production PHI we recommend Private or Dedicated.

2) PHI handling boundaries (short):
- Private (VPC/on-prem): Customer-controlled network, all model serving and KV caches stay inside the customer environment. Customer-managed KMS, audit logs, and full retention controls. Suitable for unrestricted PHI.
- Dedicated: Runs on dedicated GPU pools; storage and logs can be isolated per customer. Offers strong isolation and ability to disable non-essential telemetry. Suitable for PHI when configured with customer-managed keys and strict retention policies.
- Hosted API: Supports only de-identified or non-PHI data in typical configurations.

3) Controls that map to your must-haves:
- SOC 2 Type II: in-scope and ongoing. Evidence available via secure share.
- KMS: Customer-managed KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) supported in Private + Dedicated.
- Audit logs: Tenant-level audit logs with export and retention controls available for Private/Dedicated.

4) POC options & timeline:
- Fast lane: spin up a Dedicated sandbox (2–3 weeks infra prep + contract) — good for a performance-focused POC without full Private deployment overhead.
- Full Private/VPC: 4–8 weeks (networking, security review, and contract) depending on customer network complexity.

5) Questionnaire: I filled in top-level answers in the attached doc and flagged a few items where we need TeleMedX to confirm expected retention windows and KMS provider.

If TeleMedX can share preferred deployment (Dedicated vs Private) and retention/KMS expectations, I'll provide a compact table mapping each questionnaire item to our evidence and sample config.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
